# AscendPoint Agency

> AscendPoint builds and operates specialty marketing brands, including SERP Dental and Medical Marketing Whiz, that help local healthcare practices acquire, retain and grow patients. Headquarters: 222 Purchase St #173, Rye, NY 10580. Phone: (213) 513-7225.

AscendPoint (formerly SERP Agency) is a healthcare marketing platform. Its operating brands are SERP Dental (https://serpdental.com/, marketing for general, cosmetic, implant, orthodontic and oral surgery practices) and Medical Marketing Whiz (https://medicalmarketingwhiz.com/, marketing for med spas, plastic surgery, functional medicine, OB/GYN, weight loss and hormone therapy practices). Co-CEOs: Patrick Hounsell and Sonia Hounsell.

## Company
- [Home](https://ascendpoint.agency/): AscendPoint builds and operates specialty marketing brands, including SERP Dental and Medical Marketing Whiz, that help local healthcare practices grow.
- [About](https://ascendpoint.agency/about/): AscendPoint is the healthcare growth platform behind SERP Dental and Medical Marketing Whiz. Meet the leadership team and see how we got here.
- [Blog](https://ascendpoint.agency/blog/): Research, guides and field notes from the AscendPoint team on growing a healthcare practice in the AI era.
- [Brands](https://ascendpoint.agency/brands/): SERP Dental and Medical Marketing Whiz: specialist healthcare marketing brands that keep their names and cultures and run on one AscendPoint platform.
- [Capabilities](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/): Fifteen capabilities, organized around the patient relationship and tailored to your specialty, from dentistry to aesthetics and women's health.
- [Contact](https://ascendpoint.agency/contact/): Talk to AscendPoint. Tell us about your practice and the right person on our team will reach out within one business day.
- [News](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/): Acquisitions, launches and milestones from AscendPoint Agency and its brands, SERP Dental and Medical Marketing Whiz.
- [Results](https://ascendpoint.agency/our-results/): Case studies from SERP Dental and Medical Marketing Whiz showing the challenge, solution and results for dental offices, med spas and specialty practices.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ascendpoint.agency/privacy-policy/): How AscendPoint Agency collects, uses and protects information from visitors to ascendpoint.agency, including forms, booking tools, cookies and analytics.

## Capabilities
- [AscendVu AI Visibility](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/ascendvu-ai-visibility/): AscendVu shows how your practice appears in AI search on ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, and exactly what to publish next to get recommended.
- [AI Conversion Tools](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-ai-conversion-tools/): AI receptionist and online scheduling tools that capture patients after hours and during busy times, so fewer calls go to voicemail and fewer leads go cold.
- [Book Publishing](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-book-publishing/): Book publishing services that turn your knowledge into a book you can hand to patients, share at events, and use to stand apart from other providers.
- [Branding](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-branding/): Names, logos, and brand systems that tell patients who you are and why you are the right choice, used the same way everywhere they meet you.
- [Email & SMS Marketing](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-email-sms-marketing/): Email and SMS programs that nurture new leads, welcome new patients, and bring existing patients back for their next treatment.
- [Lead Tracking + Analytics](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-lead-tracking-analytics/): Call tracking, form tracking, and clear dashboards that show where every new patient came from and what it cost to get them.
- [Podcasting](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-podcasting/): Podcast appearances and production that share your expertise with patients and build the authority search engines and AI assistants recognize.
- [PPC Ads](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-ppc-ads/): Google Ads built around the procedures that matter most to your practice, with every call and form tracked back to the campaign and keyword that produced it.
- [Reputation Management](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-reputation-management/): Review generation and response programs that grow your star rating and show prospective patients how you treat the ones you already have.
- [SEO + AI Ranking](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-seo-ai-ranking/): Healthcare SEO and AI search optimization that puts your practice at the top of Google Maps, organic results, and AI answers from ChatGPT and Gemini.
- [Social Media](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-social-media-ads/): Targeted Meta and Instagram campaigns, with creative that feels like your practice and offers that bring patients through the door.
- [Strategy](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-strategy/): Every engagement starts with in-depth competitive market research and a plan built around the patients and procedures that grow your practice.
- [Video & Photography](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-video-and-photography/): Professional video and photography of your team, your office, and your patient experience, made for your website, ads, and social channels.
- [Webinars & Events](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-webinars-events/): Webinars, seminars, and in-office events that let patients meet you, learn about treatments, and book on the spot.
- [Website Design](https://ascendpoint.agency/capabilities/healthcare-website-design/): Fast, specialty-built websites that earn trust in seconds, rank in search, and make it easy to call, book, or request a consult.

## News
- [AscendPoint Agency Acquires Medical Marketing Whiz](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/ascendpoint-acquires-medical-marketing-whiz/): AscendPoint Agency acquires Medical Marketing Whiz, the women-led agency serving aesthetics and women's health practices, as its second operating brand.
- [AscendPoint Agency Launches the AscendVu AI Product Suite](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/ascendvu-ai-product-suite-launch/): AscendPoint Agency launches AscendVu, a dental-first AI visibility suite that shows how practices appear in AI search and what content to create next.
- [SERP Dental Acquires SparkLyfe](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/serp-dental-acquires-sparklyfe/): SERP Dental acquires SparkLyfe, a dental marketing provider focused on Google Maps rankings and the patient growth they drive.
- [SERP Agency Rebrands as AscendPoint Agency; Sonia Hounsell Joins as Co-CEO](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/serp-agency-becomes-ascendpoint/): SERP Agency becomes AscendPoint Agency, a holding company uniting top healthcare marketing providers. Sonia Hounsell joins as Co-CEO.
- [SERP Agency Refocuses on Dentistry with SERP Dental](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/serp-dental-dental-focus/): SERP Agency focuses its go-to-market and capability building on SERP Dental, a dental marketing agency built around business outcomes, not vanity metrics.
- [Fletcher Road Capital Acquires SERP Agency](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/fletcher-road-capital-acquires-serp-agency/): Fletcher Road Capital acquires SERP Agency, an SEO and website optimization agency serving dental, home services, and B2B clients.
- [Patrick Hounsell Launches Fletcher Road Capital to Acquire Specialized Healthcare Marketing Agencies](https://ascendpoint.agency/news/fletcher-road-capital-launch/): Fletcher Road Capital launches to acquire specialized healthcare marketing agencies, the first step toward building AscendPoint.
